verdict.rationale: Vendor docs claim AI-generated summaries and automatic labels/categorization for mail, which is a concrete AI insight feature, but this is limited to mail summarization/labeling with no evidence of broader suggestions, trend insights, or deeper AI-driven analysis across the product's data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of AI summary quality, evidence of AI-driven suggestions beyond categorization, and any detail on the underlying AI capabilities.
